facts.fact: The Minister for Finance's 2026/27 budget speech commits PMO-RALG with TRA to complete TAUSI-IDRAS integration, add a TAUSI module for registering, identifying and taking payments on buildings by use, and add a module letting street and village executives register all traders.

The speech assigns the TAUSI system, on which traders apply for business licences and upload TRA tax clearance certificates, to the Prime Minister's Office - Regional Administration and Local Government (PMO-RALG) for development.

systems.tiers: local government authorities; business licences, levies and taxes
